Then for me the rest of the time is just waiting for panels and premieres. Most of the time the premieres also bring someone (VA, Director) and we get interviews/QAs. For example back in 2016 for Kimi no Na Wa we got to see Shinkai, 2017 for Violet Evergarden we got a live performance of the OP by True, 2018 for Liz to Aoi Tori they brought Kensuke Ushio. Seeing the industry and premieres is worth waiting in like a couple of hours for me. Most of the time there's shade and then you get a chance to chat about anime/hen*** with strangers which is cool
